leadText: Volume 4 is the fourth volume of the Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure! manga. Authored and illustrated by 伊原しげかつ Shigekatsu Ihara.
plainText:
Volume 4 is the fourth volume of the Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure! manga. Authored and illustrated by 伊原しげかつ Shigekatsu Ihara.

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Chapters==
Chapter 1: A Novel Test!!
Chapter 2: An Enormous Power Awakens!
Chapter 3: Team Galactic's Ultimate Warrior
Chapter 4: Clash! Hareta vs. Mitsumi!!
Special Chapter: The Tale of Hareta and Shaymin

==Important events==
Mitsumi is blackmailed into rejoining Team Galactic.
Hareta defeats Candice and captures Regigigas.
Hareta and the Gym Leaders storm Galactic HQ.
Hareta comes up in a battle against Mitsumi.

==Party changes==
===Additions===
The following Pokémon are obtained:
Hareta's in DPA15
Hareta's prior to DPA16
Hareta's prior to DPA16

===Evolutions===
The following Pokémon evolve:
Hareta's to in DPA14

==Gym Battles==
Hareta defeats the following Gym Leaders:
Candice in DPA14

==Character summary==
===Hareta's party===
 

===Mitsumi's party===
 

==Trivia==
 
As the English volumes do not have dust covers like the Japanese ones, part two of the back cover gag is lost in the English release. The front cover image is moved to the end of the volume and changed into an explanation of the direction the book reads in.
